# Third-party notices

SANKHYA is built on the crates listed here. Every one is reproduced with its licence
because MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC and Unicode-3.0 each require the copyright notice to
travel with a binary distribution, and Apache-2.0 §4(d) requires upstream `NOTICE`
files to travel with it too.

**This file is generated.** Run `cargo run -p xtask -- write-attribution` after
changing a dependency; `cargo run -p xtask -- check-attribution` fails the build when it
is stale, so an added dependency cannot ship unattributed.
